C1243.title: Grey Cash-Out Schemes Spread: 'Huabei and Baitiao Cash-Out' Ads Appear on Shared Bikes
C1243.summary: A 2018 investigation found that shared bikes in Shenzhen and other cities were plastered with small ads for 'Huabei and Baitiao cash-out' services. Intermediaries convert credit line into cash by having users purchase designated products via QR code and then buying back the goods at a discount, charging service fees as high as 8%-15%. In December 2017, China's first criminal case involving illegal Huabei cash-out was sentenced at the Chongqing Jiangbei District People's Court. Du was found to have colluded with e-commerce users to fabricate over 2,500 transactions in four days, cashing out more than 4.7 million yuan, and was sentenced to two years and six months of imprisonment plus a fine of 30,000 yuan.
